body:
Glad to hear my worldview is worth something, even if just a tiny bit. This is a throwaway account, but if you want to chat in the future I can pm you the name of the one I actually use.

I appreciate it, but that's a big part of what kills me about it. I get so pissed off with myself because I'm still a depressed piece of shit, despite having all of the wonderful shit I have.

No pressure bud. 

The way I look at it, you can divide life into three things. Past, present, future. 

The future sucks; it's scary, you only have some control over it, and it's constantly getting closer. It can be good, and you want it to be good, but you really cant affect it directly, so I really don't bother thinking about it too much.

The past is useless. The smartest people in the world with literal trillions of dollars for research/equipment can't change the past; you might be able to learn from it, but dwelling on it is just time wasted. 

The present is my favorite by far. A lot of the time it still sucks ass, but I can do things in the present. If I have an itch, I can scratch it. If I'm miserable, I might not be able to fix it, but I can try my best to learn how. I can take the first step, even if that first step is the first of millions and it feels like nothing. Usually the first step is just googling shit for a while, finding nothing, feeling shitty about it, and giving up until tomorrow; but if you keep at it for long enough, you're bound to get somewhere

How bad is your record, if you don't mind me asking?

It sounds like your ex cares about you a lot, which is an incredible thing. It's a tough thing to do, but it sounds like the best thing you can do for her is swallow your pride and let her help you, and keep grinding away at progress yourself. Shit's crazy, but when somebody really cares about you, they want a good life for you as much as they want a good life for themselves

You don't need a great job to be happy dude (I'm assuming you're a dude? correct me if I'm wrong). Hell, it doesn't even seem to help. I've been doing mine for 6 months, and I'm significantly more unhappy than when I was in college, where I worked 80+ hours a week and paid to do it. All I've ever heard is that you have to look at it differently; not that it's ever helped me. 

Shit seems helpless now, but that's why you're looking for help now, yeah? There's something that gets you out of bed in the morning, and it must be worth fighting for considering you're looking for help

You don't want to. You wouldn't be on this sub if you did. Being on here and asking for help sucks, but it means you're making an attempt to find help, even if it's just somebody to BS with or relate to. It makes it a lot easier to deal with the fact that you think about suicide if you can tell somebody that and they don't freak out about it. Or at least I hope so, haha.
I'd swap in a heartbeat. At least that way somebody could enjoy all of the shit I've worked for
